description: A dynamic block without content is an error even when the collection is empty
notes: The README says the generated blocks are read as if they were written in place of the dynamic block, and an empty collection generates none, so this mistake affects no block. Whether a content block is required at all is disputed too (see native/dynamic-blocks/content-missing-is-error). hashicorp/hcl checks for the content block when it reads the dynamic block, before it iterates over the collection (expandBody.decodeSpec in ext/dynblock/expand_spec.go).
